title: Pregnant Solo #34
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Uzbek woman, an adult, in her late 50s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — but projecting forward from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, its taut round surface distinct from the heavier soft folds that continue below it toward her hips. Enormous round hips, gigantic soft thighs pressed together. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a jewelled brow ornament, deep red lips, warm olive skin, a regal composed expression, curly hair, real pores, real living eyes, 200 studs piercings set with rubies in gold-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of platinum a bracelet. Full body painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic, a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the pattern reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps, wide ochre bands following every deep crease and curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of spiral floral bands wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's natural centrepiece, the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both arms raised overhead framing her silhouette, belly and bust both fully displayed, confident direct gaze, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme ochre extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
